mapper.select: SELECT field_revision,revision FROM source_exact_head WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND approval_revision=#{approvalRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.*,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id,v.entity_kind,s.source_id,s.owner_project_id FROM source_exact_revision e JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND v.version_id=e.field_revision JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=e.source_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id WHERE e.field_revision=#{fieldRevision} AND e.source_version=#{sourceVersion} FOR UPDATE
SELECT chunk_id,raw_text,quote_hash,locator FROM source_chunk WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND chunk_id=#{chunkId}

SELECT e.source_version,e.parse_version,e.index_version,e.approval_revision,e.rights_revision,e.field_revision, b.binding_revision,f.ordinal,f.field_manifest,c.chunk_id,c.raw_text,c.quote_hash,c.locator,s.source_id,s.title FROM source_exact_item f JOIN source_exact_revision e ON e.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND e.field_revision=f.field_revision AND e.source_version=f.source_version AND e.parse_version=f.parse_version AND e.approval_revision=f.approval_revision JOIN source_exact_head h ON h.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND h.source_version=e.source_version AND h.parse_version=e.parse_version AND h.approval_revision=e.approval_revision AND h.field_revision=e.field_revision AND h.revision=e.publication_revision JOIN source_chunk c ON c.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND c.source_version=f.source_version AND c.parse_version=f.parse_version AND c.chunk_id=f.chunk_id JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=e.source_version AND sv.rights_revision=e.rights_revision JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND p.source_version=e.source_version AND p.parse_version=e.parse_version AND p.parse_status='COMPLETE' JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND g.source_version=e.source_version AND g.parse_version=e.parse_version AND g.approval_revision=e.approval_revision AND g.approval_status='APPROVED' AND g.upload_status='RECEIVED' AND g.lifecycle='ACTIVE' JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.source_version=e.source_version AND a.parse_version=e.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=e.approval_revision AND a.decision='APPROVE' JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.source_version=e.source_version AND i.parse_version=e.parse_version AND i.index_version=e.index_version AND i.status='READY' AND i.expected_count>0 AND i.expected_count=i.verified_count JOIN project_source_binding b ON b.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND b.source_version=e.source_version AND b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.is_current=TRUE AND b.applicability='APPLICABLE' JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.source_version=e.source_version AND r.rights_revision=e.rights_revision AND r.status='APPROVED' AND (r.valid_from IS NULL OR r.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE f.field_kind=#{fieldKind} AND ((f.raw_value_sha256=#{querySha256} AND CAST(f.raw_value AS BINARY)=CAST(#{queryText} AS BINARY)) OR (f.alias_value_sha256=#{querySha256} AND CAST(f.alias_value AS BINARY)=CAST(#{queryText} AS BINARY))) AND JSON_CONTAINS(r.allowed_actions,JSON_QUOTE('READ')) AND JSON_CONTAINS(r.allowed_actions,JSON_QUOTE('ENTERPRISE_USE')) AND JSON_CONTAINS(r.regions,JSON_QUOTE(#{region})) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(r.evidence_manifest,'$.environments'),JSON_QUOTE(#{environment})) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(r.evidence_manifest,'$.classifications'),JSON_QUOTE(s.classification)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM permission_grant pg WHERE pg.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pg.subject_id=#{userId} AND pg.action='source.read' AND pg.status='ACTIVE' AND pg.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (pg.valid_to IS NULL OR pg.valid_to>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.identity_modes'),JSON_QUOTE(#{identityMode})) AND (JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.purposes') IS NULL OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.purposes'),JSON_QUOTE(r.purpose))) AND (pg.resource_kind='ENTERPRISE' AND pg.project_id IS NULL AND pg.resource_id=s.tenant_id OR pg.resource_kind='PROJECT' AND s.owner_project_id IS NOT NULL AND pg.project_id=s.owner_project_id AND pg.resource_id=s.owner_project_id OR pg.resource_kind='SOURCE' AND pg.project_id<=>s.owner_project_id AND (pg.resource_id IS NULL OR pg.resource_id=s.source_id))) ORDER BY e.source_version,e.parse_version,c.chunk_id,f.ordinal LIMIT #{matchLimit}

SELECT q.*,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256,v.owner_project_id AS registered_project_id,v.entity_kind FROM source_exact_query q JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND v.version_id=q.retrieval_id WHERE q.retrieval_id=#{retrievalId} AND q.subject_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE source_exact_head SET field_revision=#{fieldRevision},revision=#{resultingRevision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND approval_revision=#{approvalRevision} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch}
